statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); printf '\033[32m%s@%s\033[0m:\033[34m%s\033[0m' "$(whoami)" "$(hostname -s)" "$(basename "$dir")"; extra=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '[(.context_window.used_percentage // empty | "ctx \(round)%"), ([(.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty | "5h \(round)%"), (.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty | "7d \(round)%")] | join(" · "))] | map(select(. != "")) | join(" ")'); if [ -n "$extra" ]; then printf ' %s' "$extra"; fi
